messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: PAGED SRE-Oncall (Charlie Patel) — Elevated 502/504 spike detected at API gateway (edge) in us-west-2. Error rate 7.2% over 5m, p95 latency 1200ms, 4 customer sessions with >10% errors. AlertID: INC-2311114455. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/incidents/2311114455

Charlie Patel: on it. paging team, i'm taking lead. anyone oncall in us-west-2? cc @Alice Martin @Ben Cho

Alice Martin: i'm available. seeing a surge on /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings routes, connection timeouts upstream to edge-proxy-backend-1.

Ben Cho: confirmed from logs — nginx upstream 502 from backend nodes (connection reset). I can check lb health and scale the gateway pool.

Charlie Patel: ok immediate mitigation plan: 1) divert 30% of traffic from us-west-2 to us-east-1 traffic pool 2) enable aggressive circuit breaker on heavy endpoints 3) scale edge-gateway replicas + restart unhealthy pods. will coordinate.

Ben Cho: running scale command now
``` 
kubectl scale deploy/edge-gateway -n prod --replicas=12 --context=us-west-2
kubectl rollout restart deploy/edge-gateway -n prod --context=us-west-2
``` 

Ben Cho: scale triggered. also toggled upstream healthcheck window to 30s to avoid flapping.

Alice Martin: putting a temporary route rule in edge routing to shift 30% traffic to us-east-1: `edgectl traffic-shift --from us-west-2 --to us-east-1 --percent 30 --reason "mitigate upstream 502s"`

Incident Bot: :white_check_mark: Action recorded: traffic shift requested by Alice Martin. 

Charlie Patel: running quick check on last 5m errors per customer — looks like 4 customers (acct: redwood-ad, stripe-prod, partner-x, internal-eval) saw >10% 5xx. Ops/CS notified. Alice, can you DM CS with tentative ETA and mitigation steps?

Alice Martin: will do. message sent to #customer-impact with a short note and link to incident page.

Maya Rivera: joining for handoff — I can take second shift and lead follow-up once traffic stabilizes. status?

Ben Cho: error rate dropped to 3.1% after scale + traffic shift, p95 down to 420ms. still seeing occasional 502s from backend pool 3. investigating root cause on backend (connection pool exhaustion?).

Charlie Patel: thanks. next temporary mitigation: enable per-route rate limiting for the heavy routes for 15m to protect backends. Applying WAF rule to reject large concurrent bursts.

Alice Martin: applied rate limit rule: `limit: 60r/s per-token-route` and WAF block for bad spikes.

PagerDuty: Incident INC-2311114455 acknowledged by Charlie Patel. Priority: P1.

Charlie Patel: quick logs — backend node 3 shows repeated TCP resets and file descriptors at 98% usage. suspect leak or slow upstream responses causing connection pile-up. Kicking a rolling restart on backend pool 3.

Ben Cho: rolling restart started:
``` 
kubectl rollout restart sts/backend-pool-3 -n prod --context=us-west-2
``` 

Ben Cho: backend pool 3 coming back healthy, healthchecks passing.

Alice Martin: error rates now 0.9% over 5m, p95 ~210ms. customer impact limited; CS confirmed messages delivered to affected accounts.

Charlie Patel: good progress. I'm going to watch for 10m to declare stable. Maya, can you take oncall handoff and own postmortem?

Maya Rivera: yes. i'll take handoff at +20m and own RCA + postmortem. assigning action items: 1) Charlie — write timeline and proofs 2) Ben — gather backend metrics and fd usage 3) Alice — customer notifications and mitigation log 4) Maya — postmortem and follow-up runbook updates.

Charlie Patel: timeline drafted in incident doc. tagging for RCA owner: Maya Rivera.

Incident Bot: :white_check_mark: Incident INC-2311114455 marked as partially mitigated. Monitoring continues.

Maya Rivera: taking over monitoring. leaving a note here: handoff to Maya Rivera at 2311114600 UTC. if any regression, page SRE-Oncall immediately.

Ben Cho: leaving logs and perf graphs in the incident doc. adding snippet of fd counts and tcp resets.

Alice Martin: CS update posted: customers notified, some reported transient failures but no data loss. we offered priority support for affected accounts.

Charlie Patel: thanks all. Post-incident tasks: run heap / fd leak analysis on backend service, consider connection pool hardening, add alert for fd usage >85%.

Maya Rivera: noted. Postmortem owner set to Maya Rivera, ETA draft by EOD tomorrow. closing live triage thread once stable window completes. :thumbsup:
